LESSON: READING 8.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we predict how a story, poem or conversation will end? 2. How can we tell where events have taken place?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the title and picture with appropriate font size and colour contrast in the text to make predictions. Learners with blindness are guided to discuss the title and picture descriptions in the text to make predictions.

2. read a text related to the theme and respond to direct questions.

3. track text using their pointing fingers (for learners with low vision). Learners with blindness to read with 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the title and picture with appropriate font size and colour contrast in the text to make predictions. Learners with blindness are guided to discuss the title and picture descriptions in the text to make predictions.
2. read a text related to the theme and respond to direct questions.
3. track text using their pointing fingers (for learners with low vision). Learners with blindness to read with 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration; the learner’s ability to speak engagingly is enhanced as they retell stories.

Creativity and imagination; the learner’s ability to make connections is enhanced as they talk about their own experiences in relation to the story.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner takes up roles assigned during group activities with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill (Self-esteem); the learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they answer questions correctly.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Reading for comprehension is necessary in all learning areas
